what: Pool Corporation distributes swimming pool supplies: chemicals, pumps, filters, heaters, tiles and equipment, delivered from about 450 sales centres to the contractors who build and service pools.
customers: Pool builders, service companies and retail pool shops across North America and Europe.
money: chemicals, parts and supplies bought every season
pumps, heaters, filters and building materials
moat: Branch density that lets a service technician collect chemicals the same morning, in a market where Pool is several times larger than the next distributor.
risks: New pool construction has roughly halved from the 2021 peak
Revenue has been flat around $5.3B for three years
The analyst average target is right where the shares trade
opportunities: A 7.7% net margin and $442M of free cash flow
About 60% of sales are maintenance products bought every season regardless of new construction
The installed base of pools keeps growing, and each one needs chemicals forever
watch: Maintenance product sales, which are the steady part, separate from new pool construction.
